initial_auto_fit.report:
PCA of 2,334 objects × 255 features (standardised to unit variance, NaN policy 'auto').
8 component(s) shown, holding 55.9% of the total variance; 241 exist.

  PC1 takes 17.37% of the variance; led by cell_channel_2_homogeneity_distance_8 (+0.12), cell_channel_1_range_intensity (+0.12), cell_channel_2_homogeneity_distance_16 (+0.12).
  PC2 takes 13.85% of the variance; led by cell_channel_0_homogeneity_distance_8 (+0.12), cell_channel_1_percentile_10 (-0.12), cell_channel_1_percentile_25 (-0.12).
  PC3 takes 6.38% of the variance; led by cell_channel_3_entropy_intensity (+0.16), cell_channel_3_mean_intensity (+0.15), cell_channel_3_percentile_25 (+0.14).
  PC4 takes 5.05% of the variance; led by cell_channel_0_channel_3_M2_correlation_15 (+0.16), cell_channel_1_channel_3_M2_correlation_15 (+0.16), cell_channel_1_channel_3_Pearson_correlation (+0.15).
  PC5 takes 4.30% of the variance; led by cell_channel_2_channel_3_M2_correlation_85 (+0.17), cell_channel_2_percentile_75 (-0.17), cell_channel_2_percentile_85 (-0.17).
  PC6 takes 3.16% of the variance; led by cell_channel_1_maxima_to_own_boundary_mean (+0.17), cell_distance_to_own_boundary (+0.17), cell_channel_0_maxima_to_own_boundary_mean (+0.16).
  PC7 takes 3.12% of the variance; led by cell_extent (+0.14), cell_channel_0_channel_2_manders_overlap_coefficient (-0.14), cell_channel_0_channel_3_Pearson_correlation (-0.14).
  PC8 takes 2.71% of the variance; led by cell_channel_3_percentile_5 (+0.17), cell_channel_3_percentile_10 (+0.17), cell_channel_3_percentile_25 (+0.15).

  ! 7 of 2,341 objects (0.3%) were dropped for missing values, so this is a PCA of the remaining 2,334. If the missingness is structural — a pathogen feature on uninfected cells — those objects are a population, not a random sample.
  ! The 255 features span only 241 independent directions, so there are 241 components and no more; the rest would be floating-point noise.
